task:

criteriaSatisfied.evidence: 已给出带严重级别的具体核查结果：high - PetWindow.cs:525-532 与 PetRenderer.cs:48-53 导致运行时 0→非0 无法启用轮播；high - PetRenderer.cs:183-202 与 PetWindow.cs:751-788 存在 130% 尺寸成长叠加路径越界风险；并区分了 HEAD 已有 playlist 能力与工作区 App 层集成。

residualRisks: high: windows-native/src/DesktopPet.Core/Rendering/PetRenderer.cs:183-202 - 130% size can produce negative/out-of-buffer coordinates and DrawFrame has no clipping; dynamic growth-overlay path may throw IndexOutOfRangeException.

high: windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Windows/PetWindow.cs:525-532 and DesktopPet.Core/Rendering/PetRenderer.cs:48-53 - changing interval from 0 to a positive value cannot create a playlist on the existing renderer.
medium: windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Windows/PetWindow.cs:700-710 - changing interval to 0 freezes the current clip instead of returning to the first clip as the UI promises.
medium: windows-native/src/DesktopPet.Core/Rendering/PetRenderer.cs:97-105 - independent random selection does not guarantee every action is shown and can repeat the same row.
medium: windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Windows/PetWindow.cs:526-529 - all sliced rows are treated as idle actions despite StateMapping assigning semantic movement/failure/work states to rows.
low: DesktopPet.App.Tests were not run because restore assets lacked net8.0-windows.
childReport.diffSummary: 只读核查；未修改文件。目标链路的工作区改动新增设置滑块、持久化字段、manager 全量下发、窗口层轮换计时和 renderer 尺寸/bob 支持；HEAD 已经具备 idle playlist 核心状态机。当前集成对首次加载有效，但运行时开关轮换不完整，并伴随尺寸 raster 越界风险。
reviewFindings: high: windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Windows/PetWindow.cs:525-532 - interval 为 0 时 renderer 以 null playlist 构造，后续运行时启用无法生效。
high: windows-native/src/DesktopPet.Core/Rendering/PetRenderer.cs:183-202 - DrawFrame 未裁剪工作区新增的溢出 SpriteRect，成长叠加路径可能越界写 buffer。
medium: windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Windows/PetWindow.cs:700-710 - 关闭轮换后不会重置到第一动作。
medium: windows-native/src/DesktopPet.Core/Rendering/PetRenderer.cs:97-105 - Random.Shared.Next 允许重复，不能满足设置页“每个动作都展示”的承诺。
medium: windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Settings/SettingsWindow.cs:1733-1739 - 设置页 PetPreviewCard 未接 playlist，与主桌宠动作表现不一致。
low: windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Rendering/SpriteLoader.cs:55-91 - 缓存加锁但没有 in-flight 去重，同 slug 并发首次加载仍可能重复解码或下载。
